title: Opinion: What Dove’s exclusive fine fragrance drop can teach beauty brands about marketing
summary: Dove’s recent fine fragrance launch, which smells like its 69-year-old hero cleansing sku Original Beauty Bar, highlights how heritage beauty brands can turn the buzz of a limited edition drop into lasting growth, says Ed Hayes, Chief Strategy Officer at creative studio Bloom
